row.name: Childrens Lighthouse Learning Center of Seabrook

occurrences.finding: Training requirements for substitutes, volunteers, and contractors-Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing: It was determined that one of the caregiver in the classroom was missing current pediatric first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training requirements for substitutes, volunteers, and contractors-Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing (26 TAC §746.1403(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: I observe caregiver supervising a group of nine children in the toddler room missing a background check. NOTE: The caregiver left premises during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment: Three staff files evaluated were missing one hour of child maltreatment training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The daycare is missing current fire marshal inspection last one expired November 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During follow-up  inspection on 4/24/2024, it was determined the background check for two caregivers present and working with children were inactive.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information obtained during the DFPS Investigation a caregiver did not use good judgment when she made a threat to a child for not laying down for a nap.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training: Based on the information obtained during the DFPS Investigation a caregiver used prohibited punishment by physically laying a child down for a nap.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training (26 TAC §746.2805(2))

occurrences.finding: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep: Based on the information obtained during the DFPS Investigation a caregiver forcefully made a child lay down for a nap.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep (26 TAC §746.2905(1))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler: I observe various training cups that were not labeled with child's name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: I observe small tricycle with a broken seat with sharp edges in the playground. Note: corrected when tricycle removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information obtained during investigation, it was determined that caregiver did not use good judgment when a child was fed the incorrect bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: I did not observe current fire marshal's insepction it expired on 10/31/23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: Two caregiver's supervising children were missing current first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment: Four caregivers records evaluated did not have current abuse neglect training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Thermometer, preferably non-glass: First aid kit located in daycare bus were missing thermometer.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Thermometer, preferably non-glass (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(7))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: I observe one of the gutter downspout loose with sharp edges accessible to children in the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined caregiver was not within child's physical proximity when she left the diaper changing table to retrieve gloves leaving child unattended for over one minute.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Must Keep Hand on Child: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined caregiver did not keep hands on the child at all times during diaper changing as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Must Keep Hand on Child (26 TAC §746.3503(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: During the inspection I observed an infant placed in a highchair without the safety straps fastened as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: During the walkthrough I observed bottles of cleaning supplies hanging from the cabinet doors in two classrooms and  cleaning supplies in unlocked cabinets accessible to children in a third class.     This was corrected when the caregivers removed the cleaning supplies and placed the products out of reach of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met: It was determined that the operation was reducing ratio during naptime for children under 18 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met (26 TAC §746.1613(a))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: The sleeping cots were not labeled with child's name or other identifying information. Note: corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: One caregiver's record evaluated was missing personnel and training information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Posting of Activity Plan: The activity plan was not posted in several classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting of Activity Plan (26 TAC §746.2209)

occurrences.finding: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met: I observe six children ages 13-months to 15-months with one caregiver during naptime. The classroom was out of ratios by one child. Note: corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met (26 TAC §746.1613(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: The director is missing current CPR/FA training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: I did not observe current annual fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Based on the information obtained, it was determined caregivers left two children unsupervised in the classroom during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: Based on the information obtained, it was determined caregiver did not count the number of children before going outside and did not notice two children left in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information obtained, there was sufficient evidence to support good judgment and self-control were not used when a caregiver was observed on video yelling at a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: The list of names for current employees was observed not available and posted during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions: The infant feeding instructions for one infant was not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions (26 TAC §746.801(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Director's Certificate: The director certificate for the director was not available to review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Director's Certificate (26 TAC §746.801(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Keep Records for 3 Months: The daily playground checklist was not available for reviewed upon request during inspection
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Keep Records for 3 Months (26 TAC §746.4751(d))
